title: Remote-content architecture proof (Addressables)
description: Make microgame content remotely updatable so cabinets can be updated from a central server, per the unity-remote-content skill. Milestone 1 needs the architecture proven with a thin path, not full fleet management.
acceptance_criteria: Microgame definitions/prefabs live in a remote Addressables group; core/framework stays in a local group baked into the build.
A boot-time routine checks for catalog updates with a short timeout and falls back to cached/local content when the server is unreachable (offline resilience).
Build-and-host steps are documented (CCD or static HTTP), with versioning/rollback notes.
The data-vs-binary boundary is documented: which microgame changes ship as remote content vs require a binary rebuild.
